name: Meliagris
source:
The harsh- looking owner of the mansion. Married to [url=/c105725]Fregerilla[/url] and father of two children, one of which is adopted.
While being vary of [url=/c105716]Mina[/url] the "Irregular", Meliagris is also highly obsessed with her. What are his inner desires, and what does he want to do with Mina in the end? Those are the main narratives in the story. 

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20040816084928/http://active-soft.jp/catalog/lostmind.html]official website[/url].]
